text:
Lee Tan: Starting rollout for v2.5.2 now. We're moving feature flag `session-aware-routing` from off->gradual-slice. Change window 22:30-01:30 UTC. Ping @oncall and @Nora Kim for metric coverage. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.5.2 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy_id=deploy-20240412-9. Actions queued: session-aware-routing: OFF -> slice(canary-a). Ramp plan: 0.5% for 12m, 3% for 10m, 15% for 15m, 40% for 20m.

Nora Kim: Confirming metric gates: abort if error_rate >0.6% for 5m OR p99 delta >180ms for 3/4 windows. Also watch session-loss rate metric `session_drop_total` > 0.1% baseline.

release-eng: I've pinned `session-routing-stable-20240301` as fallback. Quick revert command in runbook if needed:
```
rdw rollback --deploy deploy-20240412-9 --to session-routing-stable-20240301
```
Will also keep the pin command handy: `rdw pin set --route sessions --version session-routing-stable-20240301`

oncall: Alerts wired: grafana panel linked to this channel and pager. I'll mute noisy infra alerts for the ramp window and only escalate gate trips.

Lee Tan: Shadow traffic running. Enabling extra logs for first 0.5% cohort. I'll post updates at each step.

deploy-bot: Canary 0.5% applied at 1712348020. Status: in-progress. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/d/sessions/session-routing

Nora Kim: Added temporary Prom rule: `expr = increase(session_drop_total[5m]) / increase(session_requests_total[5m]) > 0.001` and routed to this channel. If it fires, mark for immediate rollback.

Lee Tan: Thanks. Proceeding to 3% in 12m if gates clear. @here
